section.title: Transform — Format & Code Converters
section.description: A fast, private collection of format-conversion tools. Convert JSON, GraphQL, TypeScript, YAML, TOML, SVG and more — right in your browser.

tools.title: SVG to JSX
tools.description: Convert raw SVG markup into a clean React JSX component with camelCased attributes and a single root element.

tools.title: SVG to React Native
tools.description: Turn SVG markup into a react-native-svg component using Svg, Path and Group primitives ready to drop into a mobile app.

tools.title: HTML to JSX
tools.description: Convert HTML into JSX: class becomes className, inline styles become objects, attributes are camelCased and void tags are self-closed.

tools.title: HTML to Pug
tools.description: Rewrite verbose HTML as terse, indentation-based Pug (Jade) template syntax.

tools.title: JSON to BigQuery Schema
tools.description: Infer a Google BigQuery table schema (name, type, mode) from a sample JSON object or array of records.

tools.title: JSON to Flow
tools.description: Generate Flow type aliases from a JSON sample so your data shapes are typed end to end.

tools.title: JSON to Go (BSON)
tools.description: Produce Go structs from JSON with both json and bson struct tags, ready for MongoDB's official driver.

tools.title: JSON to Go
tools.description: Convert JSON into idiomatic Go structs with json struct tags inferred from your data.

tools.title: JSON to GraphQL
tools.description: Derive a GraphQL type system (types and fields) from an example JSON payload.

tools.title: JSON to io-ts
tools.description: Build io-ts runtime codecs from a JSON sample for decode-time validation of untrusted data.

tools.title: JSON to Java
tools.description: Generate Java POJO classes with Jackson-friendly getters and setters from a JSON sample.

tools.title: JSON to JSDoc
tools.description: Emit JSDoc @typedef blocks describing the shape of a JSON object for typed plain JavaScript.

tools.title: JSON to JSON Schema
tools.description: Infer a JSON Schema (draft-07) describing the types and structure of a JSON document.

tools.title: JSON to Kotlin
tools.description: Convert JSON into Kotlin data classes with kotlinx.serialization annotations.

tools.title: JSON to MobX-State-Tree
tools.description: Generate MobX-State-Tree models with typed props inferred from a JSON sample.

tools.title: JSON to Mongoose
tools.description: Create a Mongoose schema definition from a JSON document, mapping values to Schema types.

tools.title: JSON to MySQL
tools.description: Generate a MySQL CREATE TABLE statement with inferred column types from a JSON record.

tools.title: JSON to PropTypes
tools.description: Produce React PropTypes definitions from a JSON object, including nested shapes and arrays.

tools.title: JSON to Rust Serde
tools.description: Convert JSON into Rust structs deriving Serialize and Deserialize with serde.

tools.title: JSON to Sarcastic
tools.description: Generate a runtime type assertion function that throws (with attitude) when data does not match the sample shape.

tools.title: JSON to Scala Case Class
tools.description: Convert JSON into Scala case classes with fields typed from your sample data.

tools.title: JSON to TOML
tools.description: Convert JSON objects into TOML configuration syntax with nested tables and readable key values.

tools.title: JSON to TypeScript
tools.description: Generate TypeScript interfaces from a JSON sample, with nested and optional fields inferred.

tools.title: JSON to YAML
tools.description: Convert JSON objects into clean, human-readable YAML for configs, docs, and data files.

tools.title: JSON to Zod
tools.description: Generate a Zod schema from a JSON sample for type-safe parsing and validation.

tools.title: JSON Schema to OpenAPI Schema
tools.description: Convert a JSON Schema into an OpenAPI 3.0 Schema Object, adjusting type arrays, nullable and unsupported keywords.

tools.title: JSON Schema to Protobuf
tools.description: Generate Protocol Buffers (proto3) message definitions from a JSON Schema.

tools.title: JSON Schema to TypeScript
tools.description: Compile a JSON Schema into TypeScript interfaces and types, including enums and unions.

tools.title: JSON Schema to Zod
tools.description: Convert a JSON Schema into a Zod schema for runtime validation in TypeScript.

tools.title: CSS to JS Object
tools.description: Convert a CSS rule block into a camelCased JavaScript style object for inline styles or CSS-in-JS.

tools.title: CSS to Tailwind
tools.description: Map common CSS declarations to their closest Tailwind CSS utility classes.

tools.title: Object Styles to Template Literal
tools.description: Convert a JavaScript style object into a styled-components template literal with kebab-cased properties.

tools.title: JS Object to JSON
tools.description: Turn a loose JavaScript object literal (unquoted keys, single quotes, trailing commas) into strict JSON.

tools.title: JS Object to TypeScript
tools.description: Infer a TypeScript interface from a JavaScript object literal for quick model typing.

tools.title: GraphQL to React Apollo Components
tools.description: Generate typed React Apollo hooks and components from GraphQL operations.

tools.title: GraphQL to Flow
tools.description: Generate Flow type definitions from a GraphQL schema for safer typed client code.

tools.title: GraphQL to Fragment Matcher
tools.description: Produce an Apollo InMemoryCache possibleTypes / fragment matcher map from a GraphQL schema.

tools.title: GraphQL to Introspection JSON
tools.description: Run introspection over a GraphQL SDL schema and output the full introspection JSON result.

tools.title: GraphQL to Java
tools.description: Generate Java classes from a GraphQL schema to speed up API model scaffolding.

tools.title: GraphQL to Resolvers Signature
tools.description: Generate strongly typed TypeScript resolver signatures from a GraphQL schema.

tools.title: GraphQL to Schema AST
tools.description: Parse GraphQL SDL into its Document AST as JSON, useful for tooling and analysis.

tools.title: GraphQL to TypeScript
tools.description: Generate TypeScript types from a GraphQL schema with @graphql-codegen.

tools.title: GraphQL to TypeScript MongoDB
tools.description: Generate MongoDB-flavoured TypeScript models from a GraphQL schema annotated with @entity directives.

tools.title: JSON-LD to Compacted
tools.description: Compact a JSON-LD document against its @context to produce a concise linked-data form.

tools.title: JSON-LD to Expanded
tools.description: Expand a JSON-LD document to its fully-qualified, context-free representation.

tools.title: JSON-LD to Flattened
tools.description: Flatten a JSON-LD document so all nodes live at the top level keyed by identifier.

tools.title: JSON-LD to Framed
tools.description: Frame a JSON-LD document against a frame to shape it into a predictable tree.

tools.title: JSON-LD to N-Quads
tools.description: Serialize JSON-LD documents into RDF N-Quads for linked-data debugging and audits.

tools.title: JSON-LD to Normalized
tools.description: Canonicalize a JSON-LD document with the URDNA2015 algorithm to normalized N-Quads.

tools.title: TypeScript to Flow
tools.description: Convert TypeScript type declarations into equivalent Flow types for migration and comparison.

tools.title: TypeScript to JSON Schema
tools.description: Generate JSON Schema from TypeScript types and interfaces for validation workflows.

tools.title: TypeScript to JavaScript
tools.description: Transpile TypeScript to plain JavaScript by stripping types, using the official compiler.

tools.title: TypeScript to Declaration
tools.description: Emit a .d.ts declaration file from TypeScript source using the official compiler.

tools.title: TypeScript to Zod
tools.description: Generate Zod schemas from TypeScript interfaces and types for runtime validation.

tools.title: Flow to JavaScript
tools.description: Strip Flow type annotations to produce runnable JavaScript, using Babel.

tools.title: Flow to TypeScript
tools.description: Convert Flow-annotated code into TypeScript to support typed migration cleanup.

tools.title: Flow to TypeScript Declaration
tools.description: Convert Flow types into a TypeScript declaration (.d.ts) style output.

tools.title: Cadence to Go
tools.description: Map Cadence (Flow blockchain) resource and struct definitions to equivalent Go struct scaffolding.

tools.title: Markdown to HTML
tools.description: Render Markdown with GitHub-flavored extensions into clean HTML for previews and publishing.

tools.title: TOML to JSON
tools.description: Parse TOML configuration into clean, portable JSON for app settings and data exchange.

tools.title: TOML to YAML
tools.description: Convert TOML configuration into readable YAML for infrastructure and app config workflows.

tools.title: XML to JSON
tools.description: Convert XML documents into compact JSON for inspection, debugging, and data pipelines.

tools.title: YAML to JSON
tools.description: Parse YAML documents into clean, portable JSON for config checks and data exchange.

tools.title: YAML to TOML
tools.description: Convert YAML configuration into readable TOML for app settings and infrastructure workflows.
